title: Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bar Kappara spoke in his name in Vayikra Rabbah 20:8, Tanchuma, Acharei 7, and Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 172b.

In Kohelet Rabbah 1:7, Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar says: “The Holy One, blessed be He, will renew the radiance of the faces of the righteous.” See Radal’s glosses there: Rabbi said it in his name to Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose.
And we find in Sotah 4a Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah (a Tanna); perhaps he is his son.

notes.text: The possible father-son relationship in the closing sentence is Hyman’s conjecture. Radal remains the supplied commentator label.

The consulted Vayikra Rabbah20:8 directly has Bar Kappara in Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar’s name. The supplied Pesikta172b is a historical folio locator; the exact edition and Radal gloss have not been independently inspected here. The proposed father-son relationship remains Hyman’s conjecture.
